This caused the bow of the canoe to turn out into the current and tip over. Those on the shore were unable to hold onto the rope because of the strength of the current and the canoe was swept downstream. Craig held onto the canoe for a couple of hours, and then he was seen to let go. He slipped under the water and did not resurface. His remains have not been recovered.
